top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a designable chemical principle, event-driven degradation by induced proximity between a target and an E3 ligase, with distinct and well-defined contributions: the PROTAC concept (Crews, Deshaies) and cereblon as the glue target (Handa). It is independently confirmed, has approved molecular-glue drugs, and opens targets without druggable pockets to clinicians. The citation can be worded to credit the concept and mechanism rather than later optimisation, and the three-name allocation is defensible, though it omits Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto, Kim and Ito. P002 is the mature fallback if the committee judges that the two strands cannot share one citation.
